facts.fact: BCEAO told every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the WAEMU to be connected to PI-SPI by 30 June 2026, then on 25 June 2026 moved the deadline to 30 September 2026 (microfinance 30 June 2027); the union includes Cote d'Ivoire, which had 23 integrated participants by late July (iAfrikan, 29 Sep 2026).

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions, microfinance institutions
